query:
SELECT vault_id,
                  initiator_user_id,
                  reason::text AS "reason!",
                  authorization_context,
                  excluded_user_id
           FROM vault_key_rotation_plan
           WHERE id = $1
             AND state IN ('preparing', 'ready')
             AND idle_expires_at > now()
             AND absolute_expires_at > now()
           FOR UPDATE
